## Why This Is Asked

```python
# Pseudocode: per-tenant embedding aggregation (DP)
def aggregate_embeddings(tenant_id, embeddings):
    dp_embed = apply_dp(embeddings[tenant_id])
    global_agg = sum(dp_embed) / len(dp_embed)
    return global_agg
```

```python
# Python sketch of the pipeline

def predict_payload(msg, vectorizer, clfs):
  x = vectorizer.transform([msg])
  cat = clfs['cat'].predict(x)[0]
```
